visualCharacteristics.purpose: Contact / next-step panel: intro text beside icon contact options (call, visit, apply, book), or equal next-step columns; optional boxed panel, text slider beside contact options, or radio-style question box

contentPattern.structure: One row (more rows allowed). First cell: intro (heading, text, optional CTA button) unless a three-up option is set. Each further cell: a contact option or group (optional icon paragraph, heading, text, link; or a list of icon + link items). A picture-only cell is an illustration; a row with an illustration beside text lays out as two equal, left-aligned halves (a lone icon paragraph sits beside the paragraph after it, and consecutive linked icons such as app-store badges form one row). slider / slider-2: the last cell is split into text slides at each heading or horizontal rule. boxed-question: a list of links renders as radio-style choices. Empty cells are dropped

reuseGuidance: Use for 'contact us', 'how to get started' and 'next steps' panels with icon links. Use columns-promo for image + CTA promos and columns-text for plain side-by-side text. Colour options (grey) are styled in the design pass
